problem.name: Boolean-function isomorphism under coordinate permutations
problem.statement_latex: Given oracle access to $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$, distinguish whether $g(x)=f(x_{\pi(1)},\ldots,x_{\pi(n)})$ for some permutation $\pi\in S_n$ from the case where every such permutation leaves disagreement at least $\varepsilon$.
problem.statement_text: Given oracle access to $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$, distinguish whether $g(x)=f(x_{\pi(1)},\ldots,x_{\pi(n)})$ for some permutation $\pi\in S_n$ from the case where every such permutation leaves disagreement at least $\varepsilon$.
